name: product-lifecycle-templates
description: 26 researched document-template bundles across the full product lifecycle, covering the complete Tier-1 floor of a 205-type catalog. Each bundle ships a lean and a full template, a worked example on one continuous scenario, an operator guide with a self-grade rubric, a deep companion, and the research log every claim traces to. 24 CI steps enforce structure, citation integrity and honest retrieval. Status experimental: efficacy was measured on 2026-08-08 and the result was VOID, and no template has yet been filled by anyone but the author.
